meta.name: draft
meta.description: Use when the user needs a written communication drafted in their voice — an email, a Slack/Teams message, a team update, an announcement, a reply to a thread, or a post. Produces a ready-to-review draft matching references/voice.md; never auto-sends external. Trigger on "/draft", "draft an email", "write a reply", "draft the update", "draft the announcement", "respond to this thread in my voice".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用你的语气草拟邮件、消息或公告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成符合个人风格的书面沟通草稿。
copy.tagline_en: Draft emails, messages, or announcements in your voice
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick drafts of written communications that match your personal style.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的语气草拟邮件、Slack/Teams 消息、团队更新、公告、回复或帖子，生成待审稿，不会自动发送到外部。
howto.when: 当你要求“草拟邮件”、“写回复”、“草拟更新”、“草拟公告”或“用我的语气回复这个帖子”时触发。

say.text: 草拟一封邮件给客户，通知项目延期。
say.note: Claude 会生成邮件草稿，包含待确认事项。

say.text: 用我的语气回复这个 Slack 帖子。
say.note: Claude 会参考 voice.md 生成回复草稿。

say.text: 草拟团队内部更新，关于本周进度。
say.note: Claude 会生成内部消息草稿，可自动发送。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude drafts emails, Slack/Teams messages, team updates, announcements, replies, or posts in your voice, producing a ready-to-review draft. It never auto-sends externally.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/draft", "draft an email", "write a reply", "draft the update", "draft the announcement", or "respond to this thread in my voice".

say_en.text: Draft an email to the client about the project delay.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a draft with open questions.

say_en.text: Reply to this Slack thread in my voice.
say_en.note: Claude will use voice.md to craft the reply.

say_en.text: Draft a team update on this week's progress.
say_en.note: Claude will produce an internal draft that can be auto-sent.
